purpose: Teach: ズーム/ベンツ/ルネッサンス/洋画/マンチェスター/ジャンボ/アドリブ/コナン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがビデオカメラのズーム機能を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Your dad taught you how to use the video camera's zoom, didn't he, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, attentive tone. Gentle rise at the end—genuinely interested, softly approving of the moment between them. Unhurried pace, the cadence of a mother who listens.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがベンツの本を見せて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad showed me this book about Mercedes cars.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine excitement. No performance—simple, direct. The pleasure in his voice is small and true. Slight lift on 'Mercedes' where his interest lives.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがルネッサンスの美術展に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Your dad's going to take you to a Renaissance art exhibition, Sho.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. Slower pace. There's something in her voice that notices the care in this—not sentimental, but genuinely moved by it. Soft finish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと洋画のアニメ観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched an animated Western film together.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact pleasure. Small, genuine. Not looking for reaction—just reporting something good that happened. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマンチェスターのお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Your dad told you a story about Manchester, didn't he, Sho?
lines.style: Reflective, almost quietly amazed. Slight pause before the question. There's recognition in her tone—of his father's way of sharing the world with their son. Gentle, wondering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとジャンボサイズのお菓子買ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought some really big snacks together.
lines.style: Simple, uncomplicated. Small genuine laugh underneath. Not embellishing—just a small, true thing. Direct delivery, warm undertone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが歌でアドリブを入れて下さったわ
lines.en: Your dad improvised while he was singing, didn't he, Sho?
lines.style: Warm recognition. Slight smile in the voice without forcing it. There's affection here—for his father's playfulness, for the moment Sho witnessed it. Unhurried, tender.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとコナンの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a Conan movie together.
lines.style: Calm, genuine contentment. Small and true—no reaching for reaction. The simple pleasure of having shared something he liked with his father. Warm close, natural trailing finish.
